hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.relative_path // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.php && "$f" != */tests/* && "$f" != */migrations/* && ( "$f" == */app-modules/* || "$f" == */app/* || "$f" == app-modules/* || "$f" == app/* ) ]] && ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse "$f" --no-progress --memory-limit=512M 2>&1 | tail -30; } 2>/dev/null || true
